correctness.rationale: For every c,e>0, 0<d<=1 and H>0, the exact 2-state transition kernel and independent Bernoulli observation inclusion-exclusion yield the probability. At fixed t1 the later observation has a strictly positive derivative, so t2=H uniquely. In exponential coordinate x, the terminal objective is strictly concave with stationary x=sqrt(r exp(-gH)); its feasibility condition is exactly H>=Hc. The strict concavity verifies every equality/boundary case and the positive-part-square improvement. An independent matrix-propagation checker produced 30800 exact-rational and numerical diagnostic assertions. Only the symbolic proof covers the uncountable parameter and time domains.

value.rationale: Exact timing of scarce surveys is a natural ecological surveillance decision when occupancy can both appear and disappear. The result resolves every admissible schedule and supplies a sharp, dimensionless terminal-clustering/staggering phase boundary, uniqueness and an explicit penalty for ignoring the boundary. Both competition mechanisms—occupancy buildup from known vacancy and redundancy of imperfect repeated tests—are structurally represented; the result is neither a special numeric computation nor a routine reparameterization. It remains an idealized model benchmark, not field-validated advice.
